description: Get receipts for many of your workspace's priced calls at once, as one statement with totals: name up to 50 usage event ids, or a period (this calendar month by default, at most 366 days), optionally for one function or agent. A period statement also counts, for each agent, the value signals set up in Settings, Value receipts. Receipts are made only when you ask. For CSV or a printable page, call GET /api/receipts with format=csv or format=html. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute or billing read scope.

agent_id.description: Only calls made by this agent. A key bound to an agent always gets only its own calls.

end_date.description: End of the period, ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

function_id.description: Only calls priced by this function.

ids.description: Up to 50 usage event ids, comma separated. Send ids or a period, not both.

limit.description: Receipts per page for a period. Defaults to 100.

offset.description: Receipts to skip for a period. Defaults to 0, at most 1000000.

start_date.description: Start of the period, ISO 8601. Defaults to the first of this month (UTC).

name: list_receipts
